lead.tldr: White House stablecoin meeting today risks CLARITY Act stalemate over yield-bearing disputes with banks. • Backpack nears $1B unicorn valuation on $50M raise tied to tokenization momentum. • Bithumb faces South Korean probe and user lawsuits after $40B fat-finger Bitcoin error. • Ledger integrates OKX DEX for secure non-custodial swaps in hardware wallets. • Binance SAFU fund swells to 10,455 BTC signaling $734M Bitcoin security commitment. • BitMine accumulates $84M ETH treasury viewing pullback as long-term entry point.

top_signals.title: Man sentenced to 20 years for role in $74 million crypto investment fraud
top_signals.summary: Daren Li, a 42-year-old key figure in an international "pig butchering" scam syndicate operating from Cambodia, was sentenced in absentia to 20 years in prison and three years of supervised release for conspiring to launder $73.6 million stolen from U.S. victims through fake cryptocurrency investment schemes. Li pleaded guilty in November 2024 after his arrest in Atlanta but fled in December 2025 by cutting off his ankle monitor, making him the first direct recipient of victim funds among eight co-conspirators to receive such a maximum sentence. The fraud involved building trust via social media, dating apps, and encrypted messages before draining victims' crypto wallets, with laundered funds moved through 74 U.S. shell companies to banks like Deltec in the Bahamas and converted to Tether. Institutional investors should note this U.S. Department of Justice enforcement underscores heightened scrutiny on crypto laundering risks, potentially impacting compliance and due diligence for cross-border transactions.

top_signals.title: Backpack exchange reaches $1 billion unicorn valuation on tokenization push: Axios
top_signals.summary: Backpack, a crypto exchange and wallet project founded by former FTX employees, is reportedly in talks to raise $50 million at a $1 billion valuation. This would make Backpack a unicorn.

top_signals.title: What should you expect from 10 February’s White House stablecoin meeting?
top_signals.summary: The White House is holding a stablecoin meeting on February 10th. The market is reacting with fear about potential regulatory changes.

top_signals.title: Ledger brings OKX DEX into its wallet in push toward secure, self-custodial trading
top_signals.summary: Ledger is integrating OKX DEX into its hardware wallet, allowing users to perform non-custodial crypto swaps directly within the Ledger environment. This integration aims to provide a more secure trading experience by leveraging hardware wallet security.

top_signals.title: Regulator vows to sue Bithumb users holding ‘unjust‘ Bitcoin after $40bn blunder
top_signals.summary: The Financial Supervisory Service is threatening legal action against Bithumb users who have not returned Bitcoin obtained due to a $40 billion blunder. Bithumb is still trying to recover $9 million worth of Bitcoin, but a Supreme Court ruling could complicate their efforts.

top_signals.title: South Korea launches probe into Bithumb over $43 billion fat-finger incident
top_signals.summary: South Korea is investigating Bithumb after a reported "fat-finger" incident where 620,000 BTC was mistakenly sent. The incident highlights potential weaknesses in the exchange's internal controls and risk management.

top_signals.title: Binance’s SAFU fund hits 10,455 BTC as $734M bet on Bitcoin grows
top_signals.summary: Binance's SAFU fund now holds 10,455 BTC, reflecting a $734 million investment in Bitcoin. This demonstrates Binance's long-term commitment to Bitcoin and its security fund.

top_signals.title: BitMine builds massive Ethereum treasury as ETH price struggles to recover
top_signals.summary: BitMine has become the largest public holder of Ethereum, accumulating a significant ETH treasury during a period of price decline. This suggests a strong belief in the long-term value of Ethereum.

top_signals.title: Lightspeed leads $70m round for events platform Naboo
top_signals.summary: Lightspeed led a $70 million funding round for events platform Naboo. Naboo cofounder Maxime Eduardo reports "spectacular growth" since launching in the US last year.

top_signals.title: How this fintech raised £70m without VC backing
top_signals.summary: Fintech company Chip has raised £70m from retail investors to build a wealth app. The app has 400k customers.

top_signals.title: Bitmine buys $84 million in ETH as Tom Lee calls market pullback 'attractive' entry point: onchain data
top_signals.summary: Bitmine purchased $84 million in ETH, while Tom Lee suggests the market pullback is an attractive entry point. The company views unrealized losses as part of its Ethereum treasury strategy during market downturns.

top_signals.title: Asia's young, tech-savvy population will power the region's growth: AIIB chief investment officer Kim-See Lim
top_signals.summary: AIIB is targeting sustainable infrastructure projects in Southeast Asia, focusing on energy and transit. The bank's chief investment officer, Kim-See Lim, highlights the role of Asia's young, tech-savvy population in driving the region's growth.
